title: The Shortest War In History
description:
The Anglo-Zanzibar War of 27 August 1896 between the United Kingdom and the Sultanate of Zanzibar lasted between 38 and 45 minutes, the shortest recorded war in history. After the suspicious death of the pro-British sultan, a new sultan took power without British permission. Britain sent an ultimatum to leave the palace by 09:00; he barricaded himself inside, and British warships opened fire, setting the palace on fire.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Anglo-Zanzibar War'.
